rows.en:
Ah, and also… there's someone I'd like you to accompany to the International Science Center.

Kitakura, show the doctor in…
This way, please…
And who is this?

Dorothy Anderson… a woman scientist known as the brains of Washington Base.

She'll attend the Earth Defense Conference, of course, and from now on she'll also be working with us as a member of the TDF Science Group.
Ah, well, a pleasure…
I'm Dorothy Anderson.
Ms. Anderson… Please, don't worry! We guarantee your safety, Doctor.
I'm sorry. I'm causing trouble for everyone at the Far East Base…
Oh, it's nothing… There's only one Earth! Washington Base, Far East Base, it makes no difference!
Now, let's hurry to the International Science Center.
So that's the International Science Center?
Come on, let's hurry…

To decide how to deal with the Space Fortress Naager, which had reached the Earth's sphere, the Earth Defense Force decided to hold a conference gathering the heads of scientific staff and related organizations scattered across its branches.
An Earth Defense Conference, you say?
Yes… It seems it will be held at the International Science Center in Kobe.
And so… you have some good idea, do you?

Not at all. I wouldn't presume to offer my opinion to Mister Brain…

We merely thought it would be a convenient chance to strike the TDF and the International Peace Organization, also known as the Red Muffler Squad, all in one blow.

I was thinking the same thing…

Striking the International Science Center where the Earth Defense Conference is held is the quickest way to paralyze the functions of every defense organization on Earth.
As expected of Mister Brain…

I so order it… I leave this operation to destroy the International Science Center entirely in your hands!

I shall also have the Brain Robots, the Iron Mask Party and Emperor Guillotine cooperate as your forces.
We are grateful for your kind consideration…
Our deepest thanks…
Scientists gathered from nations around the world were assembling here, at the International Science Center in Kobe, so as not to be detected by hostile organizations…
Captain, they say Brain Robots have appeared near the International Science Center!

What!?

What about Dan and Furuhashi?
They went to the International Science Center escorting Ms. Anderson… They haven't come back yet.

Mm… Soga and Amagi, sortie in Ultra Hawk 2 and 3!

Have the Security Squad guard the International Science Center… and request support from the Science Patrol and MAT as well!

We're protecting the International Science Center!

I won't let Brain Robots lay a hand on it! Security Squad, commence attack!
I wonder if Furuhashi and Dan made it there safely?

Yeah… Since there's no sign of the Pointer…

looks like they arrived safely, right?
Captain Kiriyama! Ganger and Sparky have appeared too! We can't do this alone…
Mm… I've just requested support! Hold out for a while…

Roger…

…!?
UCMA Special Forces, arriving now… We'll support the Security Squad! All units, commence attack!
Captain Sawa…!

No need to thank me!

We don't even know yet whether we'll be of any use…
We have to protect the International Science Center no matter what! Understood?
Leave it to us, Cap! We won't let this bunch do as they please.
Yikes… But they're all here at once. Will we be okay on our own?
No need to worry… MAT will be here soon, and it'll be an all-out battle!
Ide… Don't you embarrass us out there!
Yeah, yeah…
Captain… It's Trojan Horse and Hiryu! New Iron Mask Party robots have appeared.
What!?
I knew it… We should have sortied in the MAT Arrows…

No… We'll do it our own way!

Get as close as you can and fire your MAT Shoots into them!
Roger!

(Something's wrong…? The Brain Robots, the Iron Mask Party robots, and BF too… they're all rebuilt robots…

Why? Why is that?)
Go, don't just stand there! Let's go!
So Earth… has finally decided to face us in earnest, has it?

Yes…

They have convened something called an Earth Defense Conference, it seems, intending to rack the brains they don't have over what measures to take against our Naager.

Heh heh heh… Things are finally getting interesting.

But… there is still time before we open the "Dimension Distortion Field"… What do you intend to do next?

Yes…

Using Brain's super-production capacity, we have sent out rebuilt robots! After letting them fight long enough, we plan to send in the Alien Pedan.

The Alien Pedan?

Heh heh heh… You did well to win them over. I look forward to how the battle unfolds…

By the way, my son… what of Lucifard? Has he still not been found?

Y-yes…

We are at last beginning to see his trail, so we should soon be able to bring him back…

Mm… It is well said that the worse a child turns out, the dearer he is!

He was a son with a nature completely opposite to that fellow Apfaron's… and that is just what makes him so like me, and so dear.
Father… no… Steel Emperor Zephas, I believe Apfaron is doing well…

A sister's love, defending her brother…

Heh heh heh… How beautiful! Hahaha…
Steel Emperor…
Excuse me…

Ah… I had word from Captain Kiriyama just now.

It seems the robot armies of every organization have surrounded this International Science Center, and it's turned into an all-out battle?

But… with the Ultra Garrison here, we have nothing to fear!

Whatever interference arises, the defense conference will go ahead.
Dr. Tsuchida… This is Dr. Dorothy Anderson from Washington Base.
Oh… Ms. Dorothy, we've been expecting you!
Dr. Tsuchida… I look forward to working with you.
Ah, likewise… You are the key figure at this conference, after all.
Yes…
But… who on earth is [HERO2]'s old man?
Steel Emperor Zephas…
Steel Emperor Zephas?
He is said to be the one and only being, all-powerful and all-knowing, who rules over the entire universe… That is Steel Emperor Zephas.
An all-powerful, all-knowing being…?
Jeez, [HERO2] sure got stuck with one heck of a parent…

Ever since then… [HERO2] has been tormented by guilt.

It's very painful for me to see [HERO2] like that.

Even so, fighting for justice won't erase the sins he committed!

And [HERO2] knows that better than anyone…

That's about the size of it…

Oh, it's almost time, isn't it? Kotaro… I'm counting on you to watch the shop!
H-hey, wait a minute! Where are you going at a time like this?
Isn't it obvious? I'm attending the Earth Defense Conference.
You, Oyassan!?

What are you talking about, Shiro?

We may not look it, but we're UCMA, the TDF's support organization! And I'm the boss of you lot!

Well, I'll leave things here to you…

uncertain: U10674: 地球防衛軍 rendered "Earth Defense Force" (= TDF); 敬る read as 散る "scattered".
U10681: 戦力となろう placed as "as your forces".
U10714/U10715: ペダン星人 "the Alien Pedan" treated as a group ("win them over").
U10715-U10719: Zephas calls Lucifard (= [HERO2]) his son; Atefarina calls Zephas "Father" and Apfaron is her brother. Translated as written.
U10717: デキの悪い子ほど可愛い rendered as the proverb "the worse a child turns out, the dearer he is".
U10724: ドロシーさん rendered "Ms. Dorothy".
U10728: Tobei's 親父さん rendered "old man" (colloquial father).
U10735: "the sins he committed" - [HERO2]'s acts as Lucifard.
omissions_kept: U10727: Anderson's bare "はい…" kept as "Yes…".
